rationale: PINS gapped down ~6% on a post-earnings miss and has been grinding higher through the session, now sitting at 84% of today's range near the session high with only 48 minutes remaining. The stock is extended above VWAP ($18.62) and the 9-EMA ($18.93), making a long entry late in the day with limited upside to the high ($19.20) unattractive on a risk/reward basis; meanwhile, the broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -2.10%, VIXY +13.6%) which argues against chasing a counter-trend bounce in a fundamentally weak name. With the position already near the top of its range and close proximity to forced liquidation at the bell, the asymmetry does not favor either direction with sufficient confidence.
